prompt:
Production Unity enemy Rusher sprite animation sheet. Reference defines exact identity silhouette/proportions, redraw the same creature's articulated action frames in that view. Matte dark brown rocky armor, warm pale gray-white sinew, amber slit eyes, clean painterly pre-rendered 3D. Fixed elevated 45-degree camera, soft upper-left light. Lean athletic quadruped with very long sharp spear/wedge-shaped head and tall swept-back layered rocky armor blade along spine; dark brown plates, pale gray sinewy load-bearing legs, amber eye slit at front. FOUR limbs, single head; no sacs, no flower organs. Preserve the reference's blade-backed charging predator silhouette.
EVERY frame orientation: LEFT profile facing screen left, nose at left edge of body and tail at right; keep this direction in EVERY pose. No turning body or changing camera angle in any row.
FOUR columns and 7 rows, EXACTLY 28 complete full creatures. PORTRAIT canvas width:height=4:7. Each sprite fits central 60% of equal cell, transparent 20% margins all sides. Full bodies MUST NOT touch/overlap other frames. Same body scale and ground anchor through all states. Rows1-2: EIGHT sequential WALK frames with real articulated four-leg gait, alternating diagonal pairs, lifted feet and planted feet, stable torso. Row3: FOUR distinct IDLE breath poses, feet planted. Row4: FOUR WINDUP frames: progressively brace hind legs, lower spear head, draw torso backward ready to charge; last frame fully braced. Rows5-6: EIGHT sequential CHARGE SPRINT frames, head lowered and armor forward, vigorous alternating reach/push leg motions, body stays at the same scale and ground anchor. Row7: FOUR DEATH frames: limbs buckle, spear head and plates settle on floor, eyes darken, collapsed corpse, no explosion.
Actual articulated joints and distinct foot placements; no duplicate still frames, no rotation-only or scaling-only simulation. Four consistent legs, one head, same plates. True transparent alpha0 empty pixels and holes. No background/shadows/floor, no text/labels/grid, no particles or projectile.
